outcome: clinical outcomes of COVID-19 in pregnancy
cohort: 50 pregnant patients who were COVID-19 positive and admitted to the labor room of BJ Medical College and Civil Hospital, Ahmedabad, India, between June 2020 and mid-October 2020.
finding: Most COVID-19 cases in pregnant women were mild and responded to supportive treatment, with no evidence of poor fetal outcome, intrauterine fetal deaths, or premature deliveries.
mod_finding: 26 (52%) participants had a cesarean section delivery, and 23 (46%) delivered vaginally; one baby tested positive for COVID-19 on day 7, likely due to respiratory droplet transmission during breastfeeding.
